arguments.summary: Customer requests to pause subscription 52 instead of cancelling. Pausing subscriptions is handled by the account team and cannot be done by the agent.

outcomes.reply: The invoice 53 on your account shows a "failed" status, which means the charge did not succeed and no money was collected. According to our policy POL-BIL-002@v1 and POL-BIL-005@v1, a failed invoice is not a charge, so no refund is possible. The "past due" status on your subscription means the payment attempt failed, and you should update your payment method to resolve this. If your bank shows a charge, it might be a pending authorization that usually disappears within a few days. Please check with your bank for confirmation. Let me know if you need help updating your payment method.

arguments.query: refund for past due invoice that shows as charged but status is failed

outcomes.reply: According to the current policy (POL-SUB-003@v2), the full refund period for annual plans is within 14 days of the charge date, not 30 days. Your invoice is 25 days old, so it is outside the refundable window. Therefore, a refund is not possible for this annual plan charge. You can still keep the subscription active or cancel it to avoid the next renewal. Let me know if you need help with cancellation or anything else.
